title: Zscaler Resilience: four failure tiers from minor failures to catastrophic events

prose.text: {{bcc-relation}} Components and constraints of that deployment are in [[portfolio.business-continuity-cloud]].
Whether this resilience set has a programmatic surface is open {{gap:resilience-no-sdk}}.

checks.do: For a question about which failure tier applies, match the symptom to a tier first (node or software failure, localized outage, degradation, or full cloud outage) and answer from that tier's claim.

resilience-umbrella.statement: Zscaler Resilience is presented as a capability set ensuring continuous operations during blackouts, brownouts and catastrophic failure events.

quotes: Zscaler Resilience delivers a comprehensive capability set ensuring continuous operations during blackouts, brownouts, and catastrophic failure events.

tier-minor.statement: Minor failures are handled by automatic remediation of node failures or software bugs, with minimal user impact.

quotes: **Minor Failures**: Automatic remediation for node failures or software bugs with minimal user impact

tier-blackout.statement: Blackouts are addressed by autonomous or manual failover for localized outages and connectivity issues.

quotes: **Blackouts**: Autonomous or manual failover mechanisms address localized outages and connectivity issues

tier-brownout.statement: Brownouts are mitigated by dynamic service edge selection and customer-controlled data center exclusion.

quotes: **Brownouts**: Dynamic service edge selection and customer-controlled data center exclusion mitigate degradation

tier-catastrophic.statement: For catastrophic events, dedicated business continuity solutions maintain internet, SaaS and private application access, routing to private service edges with critical-app-only restrictions during full cloud outages.

quotes: **Catastrophic Events**: Dedicated business continuity solutions maintain internet, SaaS, and private application access; routes to private service edges with critical-app-only restrictions during full cloud outages

bcc-relation.statement: The page calls Business Continuity Cloud a separate product and the deployment surface for the catastrophic-event tier.

quotes: is the deployment surface for the catastrophic-event tier

resilience-no-sdk.title: Whether Zscaler Resilience has a programmatic surface
resilience-no-sdk.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'No SDK / programmatic surface — operational configuration only.' The Resilience capture says nothing about configuration or APIs. The vendored Python SDK has a ZPA BusinessContinuityAPI (client.zpa.business_continuity), which is not identified as part of this capability in any captured page. See portfolio.business-continuity-cloud:sdk-surface.
